summary: Instant tower attack with an optional brief beam.
overview: Damages immediately with no travel time. A LineRenderer can be assigned to flash a beam for feedback; leave it empty for a silent hit.
useCases: Laser or gun towers where the shot should always land.
A tower that must not miss fast enemies.
Cheap attacks with no projectile to manage.

params.tuning: Purely visual. Without it the attack still works, it is just invisible.
Where the beam starts. Unassigned it draws from the tower's origin, which usually looks like it comes out of the base.

gotchas.title: It cannot miss, which is a balance decision
gotchas.body: No travel time means fast enemies are no harder to hit. That is the trade against a projectile tower.
